mapper.select: SELECT TNA.outrulid,TNA.rulecode,TNA.rulename,TNA.publishorg,TNA.publishdate,TNA.rulenumber,ORG.ORGNAME FROM TBL_NBSJ_OUTERRULE TNA LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = TNA.CREATEORGID WHERE OUTRULID not in (SELECT DISTINCT OUTRULID from TBL_NBSJ_BUG_OUTERRULE where bugid=#{bugid}) and CREATEORGID in ( select to_char(two_org.ORGID) from TBL_ORGANIZATION two_org where (1 = 1 AND two_org.orgtype=0 and (two_org.STATUS != 1 or two_org.STATUS IS NULL) ) or two_org.ORGID = #{orgid} start with two_org.ORGID=#{orgid} connect by prior two_org.ORGID= fatherorgid) ORDER BY TNA.OUTRULID DESC

SELECT TNA.outrulid,TNA.rulecode,TNA.rulename,TNA.publishorg,TNA.publishdate,TNA.rulenumber,ORG.ORGNAME FROM TBL_NBSJ_OUTERRULE TNA LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = TNA.CREATEORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BUG_OUTERRULE TBI on TNA.outrulid=TBI.outrulid LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BUG TBUG on TBUG.BUGID=TBI.BUGID WHERE TBUG.BUGID = #{bugid} ORDER BY TNA.OUTRULID DESC
